metadata.description: Python coding capstone projects mapped to CBSE Class 5–8 Math & Science topics. Designed for a Class 6 student who has learned Input/Output, with hints provided. Updated with comprehensive topic coverage covering all major missing areas.

categories.input_output: Projects using only print() and input() with arithmetic operations.
categories.input_output_conditionals: Projects using print(), input() and if/elif/else statements.
categories.input_output_conditionals_loops: Projects using print(), input(), conditionals and for/while loops.

projects.name: Rectangle Area & Perimeter
projects.subject: Mathematics
projects.description: Write a program that asks the user for the length and breadth of a rectangle and prints its area and perimeter.
projects.hint: Use input() to get length and breadth (convert to float or int). Calculate perimeter = 2 * (length + breadth) and area = length * breadth. Print the results with clear labels.

projects.name: Celsius to Fahrenheit Converter
projects.subject: Science
projects.description: Write a program that takes a temperature in Celsius and converts it to Fahrenheit.
projects.hint: Use input() to get Celsius. Apply the formula: Fahrenheit = (Celsius * 9/5) + 32. Print the converted temperature.
learning_objectives: Understand and apply a conversion formula

projects.name: Average of Three Marks
projects.subject: Mathematics
projects.description: Write a program that takes marks obtained in three subjects as input and prints the average marks.
projects.hint: Take three inputs, add them, and divide the sum by 3. Use float division to get a decimal average.

projects.name: Speed Calculator
projects.subject: Science
projects.description: Write a program that takes distance (in km) and time (in hours) and calculates the speed in km/h.
projects.hint: Use input() for distance and time. Speed = distance / time. Print the speed.

projects.name: Even or Odd Number
projects.subject: Mathematics
projects.description: Write a program that takes an integer as input and prints whether it is 'Even' or 'Odd'.
projects.hint: Take input, convert to int. Use the modulo operator (%) to check if number % 2 == 0. Use if-else to print the appropriate message.

projects.name: Profit or Loss Calculator
projects.subject: Mathematics
projects.description: Write a program that takes the Cost Price (CP) and Selling Price (SP) of an item and prints whether it is a profit or loss, along with the amount.
projects.hint: Take CP and SP. If SP > CP, profit = SP - CP. Else if CP > SP, loss = CP - SP. Else, no profit no loss. Print the result with the amount.

projects.name: Triangle Type Classifier
projects.subject: Mathematics
projects.description: Write a program that takes the lengths of three sides of a triangle and classifies it as 'Equilateral', 'Isosceles', or 'Scalene'.
projects.hint: Take three side lengths. Compare them: if all equal -> equilateral; else if any two equal -> isosceles; else -> scalene. (Assume valid triangle sides).

projects.name: Acid, Base or Neutral? (pH Checker)
projects.subject: Science
projects.description: Write a program that takes a pH value (0–14) as input and prints whether the substance is 'Acidic' (pH < 7), 'Basic' (pH > 7), or 'Neutral' (pH = 7).
projects.hint: Take pH as a float. Use if-elif-else to check the value range and print the corresponding type.

projects.name: Multiplication Table Generator
projects.subject: Mathematics
projects.description: Write a program that takes a number and prints its multiplication table from 1 to 10.
projects.hint: Take the number. Use a for loop (or while loop) from 1 to 10. In each iteration, print the number multiplied by the loop variable.

projects.name: Sum of First N Natural Numbers
projects.subject: Mathematics
projects.description: Write a program that takes a positive integer N and calculates the sum of all integers from 1 to N.
projects.hint: Take N. Initialize a variable 'total' to 0. Use a loop from 1 to N, add each number to 'total'. Print the final total.

projects.name: Average of N Numbers
projects.subject: Mathematics
projects.description: Write a program that first asks how many numbers the user wants to enter, then takes those numbers one by one, and finally prints their average.
projects.hint: Take N first. Then run a loop N times. Inside the loop, ask for each number, add it to a running total. After the loop, divide total by N to get average.

projects.name: Prime Number Checker
projects.subject: Mathematics
projects.description: Write a program that takes a positive integer and prints whether it is a prime number or not.
projects.hint: Take the number. If it's less than 2, print 'Not Prime'. Use a loop from 2 to the square root of the number. If the number is divisible by any i in that range, it's not prime. Use a flag variable to track divisibility.

projects.name: LCM & HCF Finder
projects.subject: Mathematics
projects.description: Write a program that takes two numbers and finds their LCM and HCF.
projects.hint: Take two numbers. Use a loop to find HCF (Euclidean algorithm). LCM = (num1 * num2) // HCF.

projects.name: Percentage Calculator
projects.subject: Mathematics
projects.description: Write a program that takes the total marks and obtained marks and calculates the percentage.
projects.hint: Take total marks and obtained marks. Percentage = (obtained / total) * 100. Print with clear formatting.

projects.name: Simple Interest Calculator
projects.subject: Mathematics
projects.description: Write a program that calculates Simple Interest given Principal, Rate, and Time.
projects.hint: Take P, R, T as input. SI = (P * R * T) / 100. Print the interest amount.

projects.name: Equation Solver - Linear
projects.subject: Mathematics
projects.description: Write a program that solves linear equations of the form ax + b = 0.
projects.hint: Take a and b as input. If a != 0, x = -b/a. If a == 0 and b == 0, infinite solutions. If a == 0 and b != 0, no solution.

projects.name: Circle Area & Circumference
projects.subject: Mathematics
projects.description: Write a program that takes the radius of a circle and prints its area and circumference.
projects.hint: Take radius. Area = pi * r^2. Circumference = 2 * pi * r. Use pi = 3.14159.

projects.name: Number Pattern Generator
projects.subject: Mathematics
projects.description: Write a program that prints a right-angled triangle pattern of numbers.
projects.hint: Take number of rows N. Use nested loops: outer loop for rows, inner loop for columns. Print numbers in increasing order.

projects.name: Electricity Bill Calculator
projects.subject: Science
projects.description: Write a program that calculates electricity bill based on units consumed.
projects.hint: Take units consumed. Apply slab rates: first 100 units at Rs.5, next 100 at Rs.7, beyond at Rs.10. Add fixed charge.

projects.name: Speed Distance Time Calculator
projects.subject: Science
projects.description: Write a program that takes any two of speed, distance, and time and calculates the third.
projects.hint: Ask user what they want to calculate. Then take the two inputs. Apply formulas: speed = distance/time, distance = speed*time, time = distance/speed.

projects.name: Body Mass Index (BMI) Calculator
projects.subject: Science
projects.description: Write a program that takes weight (kg) and height (m) and calculates BMI with health category.
projects.hint: Take weight and height. BMI = weight / (height^2). Classify: underweight (<18.5), normal (18.5-24.9), overweight (25-29.9), obese (>=30).

projects.name: Leap Year Checker
projects.subject: Science / Mathematics
projects.description: Write a program that takes a year and prints whether it's a leap year or not.
projects.hint: A year is leap if divisible by 400, or divisible by 4 but not by 100. Use nested if-else.

projects.name: Fractions Operations
projects.subject: Mathematics
projects.description: Write a program that takes two fractions and performs addition, subtraction, multiplication, or division.
projects.hint: Take numerator and denominator for two fractions. Ask for operation. Use cross-multiplication for addition/subtraction. Simplify if possible.

projects.name: Force & Pressure Calculator
projects.subject: Science
projects.description: Write a program that takes force and area and calculates pressure.
projects.hint: Take force (N) and area (m²). Pressure = Force / Area. Print in Pascals.

projects.name: Photosynthesis Word Equation
projects.subject: Science
projects.description: Write a program that prints the photosynthesis equation and asks for inputs to calculate glucose produced.
projects.hint: Use the formula: 6CO₂ + 6H₂O → C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂. Take amount of CO₂ used, calculate glucose produced. (Simplified: glucose = CO₂/6)

projects.name: Pythagorean Theorem Calculator
projects.subject: Mathematics
projects.description: Write a program that takes any two sides of a right-angled triangle and calculates the third side.
projects.hint: Ask user which side is missing. Use Pythagoras theorem: a² + b² = c². Use math.sqrt() to find the missing side.

projects.name: Bar Graph Data Plotter
projects.subject: Mathematics
projects.description: Write a program that takes N data points and prints a simple text-based bar graph.
projects.hint: Take N values. Find the maximum value. Scale each value. Print bars using '*' characters in proportion to the values.

projects.name: Temperature Converter (All Scales)
projects.subject: Science
projects.description: Write a program that converts temperature between Celsius, Fahrenheit, and Kelvin.
projects.hint: Ask user for scale to convert from and to. Apply formulas: C = (F - 32) * 5/9, K = C + 273.15.

projects.name: Average Speed Calculator (Multiple Legs)
projects.subject: Science
projects.description: Write a program that takes multiple distance-time pairs and calculates total average speed.
projects.hint: Use a loop to take distances and times for each leg. Calculate total distance and total time. Average speed = total distance / total time.

projects.name: Electricity Units Usage Calculator
projects.subject: Science
projects.description: Write a program that takes power rating and usage time for multiple appliances and calculates total units consumed.
projects.hint: For each appliance, ask power (W) and time (h). Calculate units = power * time / 1000. Sum all units. Print total units.

projects.name: Quadratic Equation Solver
projects.subject: Mathematics
projects.description: Write a program that solves a quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0.
projects.hint: Take a, b, c. Calculate discriminant = b² - 4ac. If positive, two real roots. If zero, one root. If negative, complex roots. Use math.sqrt().

projects.name: Solar System Distance Calculator
projects.subject: Science
projects.description: Write a program that takes planet name and prints its distance from the Sun.
projects.hint: Use if-elif-else or dictionary to map planet names to distances (in million km). Print the distance.

projects.name: Ratio and Proportion Solver
projects.subject: Mathematics
projects.description: Write a program that takes two ratios and checks if they are in proportion.
projects.hint: Take a:b and c:d. Check if a*d == b*c. Print whether they are proportional.

projects.name: Gravity Weight Calculator
projects.subject: Science
projects.description: Write a program that takes mass and calculates weight on Earth and Moon.
projects.hint: Take mass (kg). Weight on Earth = mass * 9.8. Weight on Moon = weight_on_earth / 6. Print both.
